chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Faithfulness with the people of treachery is treachery with Allah, and treachery with the people of treachery is faithfulness with Allah.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْغَدْرِ: The people of treachery / The deceitful
key_terms.عِنْدَ اللهِ: In the sight of Allah / With Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between faithfulness and treachery in the sight of Allah according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this profound maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the principle of *al-wafa'* (fulfillment) as context-dependent rather than absolute, drawing on the Shia scholarly tradition of *siyasa al-murta'a* (governance of the deceitful). He posits that fidelity to the treacherous enables their deception and is thus deemed 'deceit' by Allah, whereas strategic reciprocity with them is considered 'faithfulness' to the divine order. This highlights the dynamic nature of moral virtue in human relations, where the recipient's character influences the spiritual valuation of the action.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 259. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him,
said: Faithfulness with faithless people is faithlessness with Allāh, while faithlessness with faithless people is faithfulness with Allāh.
